title: Recommend Me a Basic Bike Computer
body:
My simple wired Cateye Velo of 15 years has given out.
Just want Speedometer + Distance Traveled/Ride Time/Odometer/Clock/Temperature - don't care for personal monitors etc.
Wireless GPS look the goods - never used this type before…had a look at AliExpress…several options around $20-30….anyone have experience to share?
Cheers
